services.desc: Welcome to the ultimate deep sea fishing adventure in Kona, Hawaii. Located in the heart of Kailua-Kona at Honokohau Harbor, Fire Hatt Sportfishing offers world-class, action-packed offshore fishing charters. Whether you are a family looking for a fun day on the water or a serious angler chasing a tournament-winning “Grander” Marlin, our experienced crew is dedicated to delivering an unparalleled, high-end experience on the calm waters of the Kona coast. We cater to all experience levels and offer private charters for up to 6 guests.
